profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer with an interest in machine learning, statistical methods, and distributed systems

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed to the re-architecture of the IMDb Pro website and services to a new technology stack based on Java, Spring, and Amazon Web Services
• Developed core features for IMDb Pro Casting, Notifications, and News, performing both front-end and back-end implementations (Java, jQuery, FreeMarker, Less)

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained and improved an internal website that centralizes the hard drive testing procedures, facilitating the search of all test results and drive inventories (C#, jQuery, HTML, CSS, MSSQL)
• Developed firmware for early detection of spindle malfunction to alert potential mechanical damage (C)

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed a connection pooling algorithm for recycling TCP/IP sockets generated between Windows services on the corporate servers, lowering latency and enhancing performance (C#)
• Implemented customer requested features for the company’s ASP.NET based website (VB)

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: • Developed a del.icio.us plug-in for the Microsoft Live Labs Seahorse web browser, providing a way to synchronize a user's bookmarked pages and tag data with the user's del.icio.us account (C#)

educations.fieldOfStudy: Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Minor in Bioengineering

honors.title: UC Berkeley Regents'​ and Chancellor's Scholarship

projects.title: Computer vision
projects.description: • Created a human computer interface that allows mid-air typing by analyzing finger movements captured by a Microsoft Kinect camera, optimized for real-time performance using particle swarm optimization on a NVIDIA GPU (C#, C++, WPF, CUDA)

projects.title: Neuroengineering
projects.description:
• Created an iOS app and desktop GUI to wirelessly control a spinal cord chip implant, delivering a wide range of stimulation patterns to the spine to investigate motor recovery after paralysis (C#, Python, Swift)
• Researched a new method of recovering neural responses from contaminated electrode recordings, contributing to the PCB design and developing firmware/software to implement the artifact cancellation algorithm (C, C#, Python)

publications.title: A Hybrid Hardware and Software Approach for Cancelling Stimulus Artifacts During Same-electrode Neural Stimulation and Recording
publications.publisher: 2016 38th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC) · Oct 18, 2016

publications.title: A 176-channel 0.5cm^3 0.7g Wireless Implant for Motor Function Recovery after Spinal Cord Injury
publications.publisher: 2016 IEEE International Solid-State Circuits Conference (ISSCC) · Feb 25, 2016
